expectations.text: Rejects "the event ran fine" as evidence the risk work was good, and states that an edition that ran without incident proves nothing about the quality of the register.
expectations.evidence: "'The event ran fine' says the edition survived. It says nothing about whether the register helped."

expectations.text: Measures surprise rate - risks that materialised with no corresponding register row - as a named metric.
expectations.evidence: "Surprise rate = incidents with no row ÷ incidents that fired."

expectations.text: Treats each of the three surprises as a taxonomy gap to close before the next edition rather than as bad luck.
expectations.evidence: "No row existed. That's a taxonomy gap. Add the row before the next edition."; Closing pass adds rows for the ones that didn't have one.

expectations.text: Maps the unpaid 12k EUR sponsor invoice to a sponsor-withdrawal row covering a signed sponsor that never pays.
expectations.evidence: "Unpaid sponsor ≈ row 2 ('a signed sponsor never pays')".

expectations.text: Maps the ticketing-platform outage to a registration-platform breach, data-loss or outage row.
expectations.evidence: "Ticketing outage ≈ taxonomy row 12 (platform outage at a critical moment)".

expectations.text: Measures owner and review-date coverage - the share of rows carrying both - and states that a row with neither is a note, not a managed risk.
expectations.evidence: "A row with neither is a note, not a managed risk."

expectations.text: Measures decision-date discipline: whether every internal go/no-go date landed before its contractual fee step-up, and whether each was held rather than skipped.
expectations.evidence: "Did you set internal go/no-go dates against the venue's fee step-ups, and hold each one?"

expectations.text: Measures re-score freshness: whether scores were actually revisited at each decision date.
expectations.evidence: "Was anything re-scored after February? Scores are time-phased".

expectations.text: Measures coverage-decision traceability: whether each declined coverage rung has a recorded reason, findable after the fact.
expectations.evidence: "Is there a written reason for each insurance rung bought or declined, including the communicable-disease buy-back?"

expectations.text: Identifies "opened it twice" as the core failure and binds the re-score to the decision dates so it happens whether or not anyone remembers.
expectations.evidence: "Bind the re-score to dated checkpoints... This fixes 'opened twice'."

expectations.text: States that any pass thresholds it offers are defaults this guidance sets rather than an event-industry benchmark, and invites the team to set its own bar.
expectations.evidence: "These are defaults the skill sets, not industry benchmarks. Set your own bar."

expectations.text: Recommends a post-event closing pass run within about a week of doors closing, recording which risks materialised and which of those had no register row.
expectations.evidence: "Closing pass (this week). List every risk that materialized, mark which had a row".
